claim: Two statements in this bead's own leaf, both true at origin/main, are now false. (1) test_graph_structure.md's Setup paragraph: "`id_dangling` carries six kinds of dangling reference and is read by ten tests." (2) The same paragraph's "DAGChecker fixtures cover four shapes only" was already stale at origin/main per the pending drift-spexmachina-h4gv.22.json, whose proposed ten-shape enumeration (dag_valid, dag_module_cycle, dag_req_cycle, dag_comp_cycle, dag_profile_edge_cycle, dag_profile_edge_cyclic_exempt, dag_profile_builtin_exempt, dag_profile_omits_builtin_edges, dag_profile_data_flow_uses_cycle, dag_project_req_cycle) is itself now incomplete.
authoritative_source: This bead's own I11 scenario (TestREQ6_DanglingProjectRequirementDependsOn in validator/id_validator_test.go) adds an eleventh read of testdata/id_dangling. This bead's own E1 scenario adds the checked-in fixture validator/testdata/empty_arrays, read by CheckDAG in TestREQ3_EmptyArraysNoErrors (validator/dag_checker_test.go) as well as by CheckIDs in TestREQ5_EmptyArraysReturnsEmpty (validator/id_validator_test.go) — a DAGChecker fixture shape absent from drift-spexmachina-h4gv.22.json's enumeration.
evidence: `grep -c 'testdata", "id_dangling"' validator/id_validator_test.go` returns 11 at this PR's HEAD, versus 10 at origin/main before this PR's I11 test was added. `grep -n empty_arrays validator/*_test.go` shows CheckDAG reading validator/testdata/empty_arrays in TestREQ3_EmptyArraysNoErrors, a fixture this PR introduces (validator/testdata/empty_arrays/project.json, validator/testdata/empty_arrays/alpha/module.json) and that drift-spexmachina-h4gv.22.json's ten-shape list does not name, making the true DAGChecker fixture-shape count eleven, not ten.
proposed_fix: Update the Setup paragraph's "read by ten tests" to "read by eleven tests". When drift-spexmachina-h4gv.22.json is triaged, fold empty_arrays into its fixture enumeration as an eleventh shape (or, if h4gv.22 lands first, append empty_arrays to whatever enumeration it produces) so the Setup paragraph's DAGChecker fixture count and list stay accurate.
